correctionNotes: No exact AutoEq/public measurement match was found for EBX25Ti; do not treat prose-derived EQ as exact correction.
Assume stock full foams and a stable fit. Add only a gentle low shelf plus a small mid-bass reinforcement; avoid trying to force sealed-IEM sub-bass from an open flathead.
Keep the naturally clear/forward upper mids largely intact; use only a mild broad trim around 3 kHz.
Foam and fit dominate the result: ring/no-foam use may need slightly more bass, while a tight full-foam fit may need less. Re-tune by ear in 0.5-1 dB steps.
signature: Fit/foam-dependent semi-open flathead: clear, forward upper mids and wide presentation; clean bass with modest impact but useful extension when full foams achieve a stable fit; generally smooth, non-fatiguing treble. Review tonal descriptions vary from neutral-bright to warm, so treat this as an estimated baseline.
source: Estimated from text reviews; no EBX25Ti AutoEq match.
